title: Sleep Network SEO & Content Strategy

thesis.core: Sleep is a location, not an achievement. Nobody clicks 'for sleep' — they click where they want to feel like they are.
five_laws: Place, not topic. Every offering sells somewhere to BE.
Engines, not channels. Build six engines, get fifty channels.
Hosted beats abandoned. One recognizable voice, one goodnight ritual.
Difficulty is a lullaby. Tracking-load near zero is what sleeps people.
Data grows the organism. Every pilot emits tracked IDs; verdicts promote or kill.

rules: Use 'to sleep to' or 'to fall asleep to' as suffix
Power words: Gentle, Calm, Relaxing, Deep, Slowly
Avoid 'NO ADS' in title (save for description)

structure: Line 6-10: Benefits (helps you sleep, relax, study)
description_strategy.template: Fall asleep to [topic] with this [duration] [format]. [Benefit 1]. [Benefit 2]. Perfect for [use case]. [Timestamps]. [Related videos]. #sleep #fallasleep

watch_time_optimization.sleep_advantage: Sleep videos have 3-10 hour watch times. This is the #1 ranking signal.
strategies: No cliffhangers (sleep content must be drop-safe)

metrics.completion_rate: Low percentage but high absolute hours

mechanisms.description: Content-desires that drive viewer behavior. Each channel must name its mechanism.

list.completionism: Finish together. Libraries, series, collections. Desire: endings.
list.place_habitation: Be somewhere. Rooms, cities, bunkers. Desire: location, not topic.
list.difficulty_lullaby: Surrender. Hard content, permission to stop tracking. Desire: permission.
list.hosted_company: Not alone. A kind voice in the room. Desire: companionship.
list.ritual: Same beats nightly. Predictability as safety. Desire: routine.
list.nostalgia: Known things. Fairy tales, covers, recipes. Desire: the past, curated.
list.eavesdropping: Overhear, uninvolved. Presence without stakes. Desire: passive engagement.
list.proportion: Dwarf the worry. Cosmos, deep time. Desire: smallness as relief.
list.suggestion: Dream incubation. Manifestation, daimon encounters. Desire: direction while drifting.
list.collection: Complete the set. Elements, flags, constellations. Desire: full sets.
list.curiosity_gap: One question gentle enough to sleep on. Etymology, lore. Desire: gentle inquiry.
list.contrast_comfort: Safe inside. Bunker, storm outside. Desire: danger at a distance.
list.rhythm: Predictable cadence. Timetables, numbers, lists. Desire: pattern without meaning.
list.sensory_memory: Taste/smell. Recipes, teas, spices. Desire: comfort through senses.
list.procedural_calm: Follow steps. Assembly, painting, trades. Desire: tasks that complete themselves.
list.absurd_delight: Boring made joyful. Labels, warranties, legal. Desire: laughter too tired to laugh.
list.linguistic_drift: Words as water. Etymology, roots, thesaurus. Desire: meaning dissolving into sound.

rules: New channel: >=1 type tag + >=1 mechanism tag
New tag: three channels sharing unnamed pattern
Tags resolve in analytics content-feature view

upload_strategy.playlist_structure: One playlist per series. Add new videos. Cross-promote.

scoring.pre_launch: EV = readiness × shelf_band × moat × engine_economy × demand

common_mistakes: Generic title (e.g., 'Sleep Video 23' instead of descriptive)
Not adding to playlists (misses session watch time)
Using faces in thumbnails (breaks faceless format)
Adding music to narration (distracts from sleep)
